meta.title: Create an account with your phone
meta.description: Create a Friends of Animals account with your mobile number. We text you a code: there is no password to remember.

signUp.title: Create an account with your phone
signUp.lead: Tell us your name and your mobile number. We'll text you a code to finish. There's no password to remember.

meta.title: Sign in with your phone
meta.description: Sign in to Friends of Animals with your mobile number and a code we text you. There is no password.

signIn.title: Sign in with your phone
signIn.lead: Enter your mobile number and we'll text you a code. There's no password.
signIn.otherLink: Create an account with your phone

option.signIn: Prefer your phone? Sign in with a code by text message
option.signUp: Prefer your phone? Create an account with a code by text message

off.message: We can't text sign-in codes yet, so codes come by email for now.
off.signUp: Create an account with your email

phone.label: Mobile number
phone.hint: An Indian mobile number. We'll text a 6-digit code to it.
phone.error: Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number, like 98765 43210.

code.label: 6-digit code
code.hint: We sent it to {contact}. It works for {minutes} minutes.
code.error: That code isn't right. Check the text message and try again.

alerts.rate_limited: You've asked for a lot of codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
alerts.rate_limited_hours: You've asked for a lot of codes today. Try again in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
alerts.code_expired: That code has run out. Send yourself a new one.
alerts.too_many_attempts: That code had too many wrong tries. Send yourself a new one.
alerts.no_account: There's no account with this phone number yet.
alerts.unsupported_country: We can only text Indian mobile numbers for now.
alerts.sms_disabled: We can't text codes right now. Please try again later.
alerts.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
